> 第9章 绝不要仁慈（第1页）
“我不行？还不是拜你们所赐？哼！”柳大春一丝冷笑，看着眼前的郑秋秋婶婶，这个年纪，那熟女味真是要满出来。
郑秋秋整个人就倒在了地上，柳大春整个人脑袋就凑在了郑秋秋的怀里。
“哎呀，你不是傻子吗？怎么你个傻子。”
这个时候的吴坤被打肿了脸，听见草丛里有媳妇的反抗声，心里暗骂：“妈地，傻大春，你个乌龟王八蛋，还真的欺负我媳妇？？”
吴坤这打不过，看了看，这傻大春的箩筐还放在这里，说里面是蛇，他是不信的。
“傻大春，你意思一下就够了，你要再欺负我媳妇，我就把这蛇全放了。”
吴坤说着，一脚朝箩筐踢了过去，那箩筐本来就圆的，被这一踢，就滚落山下去。
这傻子，傻时，根本就不知道什么叫女人，家里有个师娘，村里那么多女人，都是暴殄天物，不知道享用，每天最开心的事竟然是吃饭，睡觉，抓鱼？
柳大春这个年纪，本就是青春烈焰，精力充沛，加上和这锦鳞蚺兽合二为一，更是势不可挡。
郑秋秋大骂着，却丝毫讨厌不起来，还有点小喜欢。
这时，听见草丛外吴坤要放生蛇，这反而让他急了，自己还要靠这蛇做药酒，拿镇上去卖呢，明天还要给吴嫂还钱，可不能丢！
“吴坤，你他妈找死！”柳大春大骂了一句，对郑秋秋说道：“先欠着，改日要你这身体债。”
“什么还欠着，过了今日可就什么都没了。”郑秋秋思维倒也是缜密。
柳大春跑出去时，吴坤已经不见了，只见自己的箩筐正往下滚，便当即追赶过去。
另一边，吴坤见柳大春跑了，才松了口气，急忙跑去了草丛，检查起媳妇的情况来。
“媳妇，傻春把你办了？”吴坤急道。
“嘿嘿，我就说吗，他是个傻子，根本就不懂的，我跟你说，他压根不知道该干什么的！！傻子就是傻子！”吴坤说着满嘴都是疼。
郑秋秋也不清楚这傻大春是真傻还是假傻，不过这傻子显然还是更关注他的蛇，连女人都不要，说明还是个傻子，哈哈！

“妈地，这傻子这次打了我，我定给他好颜色看，哼，哪天这傻子不在家，我把他师娘给办了，哈哈。”吴坤坏到骨子里了，柳大春就不该手下留情。
这师娘杨桃花的美和身材，全村的男人那都惦记着呢。
“好了，我把他的蛇都给踢了，让他哭去，算是报仇了，走，咱们回家去。”吴坤说道。
然后他还没意识到，就这一脚踢，把自己的命都给踢没了。
“嗯嗯，奶奶的，这傻子差点。”郑秋秋也不好说下去，但是，她有一种说不出的渴望。

> Chapter 9 Never be merciful (page 1)
"I can't do it? Why don't I thank you for your help? Huh!" Liu Dachun sneered and looked at Aunt Zheng Qiuqiu in front of him. At this age, her mature womanhood is really coming out.
Zheng Qiuqiu fell to the ground, and Liu Dachun's head rested on Zheng Qiuqiu's arms.
"Oh, aren't you a fool? Why are you a fool?"
At this time, Wu Kun's face was swollen from being beaten. He heard his wife's resistance in the grass and cursed in his heart: "Damn it, silly Dachun, you turtle bastard, are you really bullying my wife??"
Wu Kun couldn't beat him. He took a look and saw that the silly Dachun's basket was still here. He didn't believe it when he said there was a snake in it.
"Silly Dachun, just your thought is enough. If you want to bully my wife again, I will let all the snakes go."
Wu Kun said, and kicked the basket. The basket was originally round, but after being kicked, it rolled down the mountain.
This idiot, when he was stupid, didn't know what a woman was at all. He had a mistress at home, and there were so many women in the village who wasted their wealth and didn't know how to enjoy it. The happiest things every day turned out to be eating, sleeping, and catching fish?
At Liu Dachun's age, he was a youthful flame, full of energy, and combined with this golden-scaled anaconda beast, he was even more unstoppable.
Zheng Qiuqiu cursed, but he didn't hate it at all, and he still liked it a little bit.
At this time, he heard that Wu Kun was about to release a snake outside the grass, which made him anxious. He also relied on the snake to make medicinal wine and sell it in the town. He had to pay back the money to Mrs. Wu tomorrow, so he couldn't lose it!
"Wu Kun, you're looking for your fucking death!" Liu Dachun cursed and said to Zheng Qiuqiu: "I owe it to you now, and I will demand your physical debt another day."
"What do you still owe? After today, you will have nothing." Zheng Qiuqiu's thinking was very careful.
When Liu Dachun ran out, Wu Kun had disappeared. He only saw his basket rolling down, so he immediately chased after him.
On the other side, Wu Kun was relieved when he saw Liu Dachun running away, and hurriedly ran to the grass to check on his wife's condition.
"Daughter-in-law, has Shachun done this to you?" Wu Kun asked anxiously.
"Hehe, let me just say that he is a fool and doesn't understand at all. Let me tell you, he doesn't know what to do at all!! A fool is a fool!" Wu Kun said with his mouth full of pain.
Zheng Qiuqiu didn't know whether this stupid Dachun was really stupid or fake, but this fool obviously paid more attention to his snake and didn't even want women, which meant he was still a fool, haha!
"Damn it, this idiot hit me this time. I will show him a good look. Hum, one day this idiot is not at home, I will deal with his wife, haha." Wu Kun was bad to the core, Liu Dachun should not show mercy.
The beauty and figure of Yang Taohua, the master's wife, are all the men in the village are thinking about.
"Okay, I kicked all his snakes and made him cry. This is considered revenge. Let's go home." Wu Kun said.
Then before he realized it, he kicked him and killed himself.
"Yeah, grandma, this fool is almost there." Zheng Qiuqiu couldn't continue, but she had an indescribable desire.
